changelog: Adds a plugin-repository manifest.json, so the plugin can be installed from Dashboard > Plugins > Repositories instead of only by unpacking a ZIP. The manifest now reports the same four-part version as meta.json. Still built against Jellyfin.Controller/Model 12.2.0 on net10.0 and requires Jellyfin 12.2 or newer.
name: Media.CCC.de
description: Jellyfin plugin for media.ccc.de conference recordings
overview: Browse and watch media.ccc.de conference recordings as TV Series in Jellyfin
